title: Validation of colony sampling, microculturing and sfGFP expression in E. coli BL21(DE3) (APEX Protocols 1-4)

containers.name: competent_cells_tube
containers.description: Calcium-competent BL21(DE3) cells in 0.1 M CaCl2 + 15% glycerol, kept on ice

containers.name: lb_reservoir
containers.description: Plain LB (diluent for spot dilution, OD readout and blanks)

containers.name: lb_carb_reservoir
containers.description: LB + 100 µg/mL carbenicillin for overnight cultures and subcultures

containers.name: transform_plate
containers.description: Thermocycler PCR plate for heat shock transformation; columns 1-8 = pEX05 (sfGFP), column 9 = pEX01 control

containers.name: dilution_plate
containers.description: Plate for 5-fold dilution of transformations spotted at low density (columns 5-8)

containers.name: agar_plate
containers.description: Nunc OmniTray with LB agar + 100 µg/mL carbenicillin, 8x12 spot grid (modelled as a 96-position plate; agar not liquid)

containers.name: overnight_plate
containers.description: 96 deep-well plate for overnight cultures inoculated from sampled colonies

containers.name: od_plate
containers.description: Clear 96-well plate for 1:10 OD600 readout of overnight cultures, with LB blanks in column 10

containers.name: subculture_plate
containers.description: 96 deep-well plate for back-diluted subcultures, induced with L-arabinose

containers.name: reader_plate
containers.description: Clear-bottom black 96-well plate for the Varioskan LUX time course

steps.action: Prepare Hanahan calcium-competent BL21(DE3): inoculate a single colony in 5 mL LB, grow overnight at 37 °C with shaking; dilute 100-fold into 50 mL LB and grow at 37 °C, 300 rpm to OD600 = 0.4; chill on ice 20 min; pellet at 4000 ×g, 4 °C, 10 min; resuspend in 2 mL 0.1 M CaCl2 + 15% (v/v) glycerol; store at -80 °C. Thaw on ice before use (commercial Thermo BL21(DE3) cells may be substituted).
steps.source_quote: The overnight culture was 100-fold diluted into 50 mL of fresh LB medium to grow at 37 °C and 300 rpm until it reached OD600 = 0.4.
steps.note: Can be skipped if competent cells are already available

steps.source_quote: APEXProtocol 1 used reduced volumes (LV configuration, 10 µl cells, 50 µl SOC)
steps.note: LV configuration assumed for Fig. 5; 72 transformations (8 rows x 9 columns)

steps.source_quote: All transformations used 1 µl of DNA at 1.5 × 10−4 pmol.
pEX05 encoding sfGFP (Columns 1-8), and pEX01 (Column 9, positive control)

steps.action: Seal transform_plate and run in the thermocycler: 4 °C for 30 min, then heat shock at 42 °C for 30 s (rapid ramp), returning immediately to 4 °C.
steps.source_quote: By default, cells are incubated at 4 °C for 30 minutes, heat shocked at 42 °C for 30 seconds, and recovered with SOC medium at 37 °C for 1 hour.
recovered with SOC medium at 37 °C for 1 hour

steps.action: Incubate transform_plate in the thermocycler at 37 °C for 1 h for recovery.
steps.source_quote: recovered with SOC medium at 37 °C for 1 hour

steps.action: Weigh the empty and the agar-filled OmniTray (about 30-35 mL LB agar + 100 µg/mL carbenicillin, assumed). Agar height = (plate+agar weight - empty plate weight) / (base area x 0.911 g/cm3). Set the spotting height to about 1-2 mm above the calculated agar surface (assumed offset).
steps.source_quote: calculating agar height from the plate base area, weight, and agar density
diluted five-fold (Columns 5-8) onto selective agar to generate high- and low-density colonies respectively
diluted five-fold (Columns 5-8) onto selective agar
Cells were spotted directly (Columns 1-4)
pEX01 (Column 9, positive control)
Spotted cells (5 µl) were plated on antibiotic-supplemented LB agar

steps.action: Let spots dry, then incubate the agar plate inverted at 37 °C for about 16 h until colonies form.
steps.source_quote: cells are plated on a selective solid medium, typically Lysogeny-Broth (LB) agar supplemented with antibiotic
steps.note: Time and temperature not stated in paper

steps.source_quote: APEX inoculates cells into fresh LB-antibiotic by mixing media in a 96 deep well plate

steps.action: Single pierce sampling: with a fresh tip per spot, lower the tip to the centre of each spot in agar_plate columns 1-4 (high density) and column 9 and just into the agar, then withdraw.
steps.source_quote: a single pierce sampling method for high cell densities, where the tip directly targets the centre of the initial cell dispension
steps.note: Pierce depth assumed; column 9 sampled by pierce (assumed)

steps.source_quote: APEX inoculates cells into fresh LB-antibiotic by mixing media in a 96 deep well plate
steps.note: Mix with the same tip that sampled the colony to release cells

steps.action: Spiral sampling: with a fresh tip per spot, start at the centre of each spot in agar_plate columns 5-8 (low density) and trace slow, smooth spirals outward (radius about 1-2 mm, about 2-3 rotations, about 8-16 points), keeping the tip just below the agar surface.
steps.source_quote: a spiral sampling method, where the pipette traces a spiral motion from the same centre coordinates outward for low or uneven cell densities
APEX inoculates cells into fresh LB-antibiotic by mixing media in a 96 deep well plate

steps.action: Seal overnight_plate with a gas-permeable membrane and incubate overnight (about 16-18 h) at 37 °C with vigorous shaking (about 250 rpm).
steps.source_quote: After successful transformation and overnight culturing, cells are primed for protein expression induction.
Growth comparison (OD600) of overnight cultures
Growth comparison (OD600) of overnight cultures
Growth comparison (OD600) of overnight cultures sampled using Protocol 3’s two methods

steps.action: Read OD600 of od_plate in a plate reader; subtract LB blank and correct for the 1:10 dilution.
steps.source_quote: To monitor cell growth, we developed a protocol that automates the preparation of samples for Optical Density at 600 nm (OD600) measurements in a microplate
APEX propagates cells in fresh LB-antibiotic media using an aliquot of the overnight culture.
Overnight cultures of E. coli BL21(DE3) transformed with the pJKR-H-araC plasmid were diluted and grown to an OD600 of approximately 0.2

steps.action: Seal subculture_plate with a gas-permeable membrane and manually transfer to a shaking incubator at 37 °C (about 250 rpm) until OD600 is approximately 0.2 (about 2-3 h; check OD600 by manual read).
steps.source_quote: The plate with subculture is then manually transferred to a shaking incubator until cells reach mid-log phase.
at which point they were induced with 1.33 mM L-arabinose
steps.note: 6.7 µL of 100 mM into about 500 µL gives about 1.33 mM final; column 9 receives no inducer (negative control)

steps.source_quote: 150 µL of cells were transferred to a clear-bottom 96-well black plate

steps.action: Incubate reader_plate in a Varioskan LUX at 37 °C with shaking at 960 rpm (high speed); measure OD600 and sfGFP fluorescence (excitation 485 nm, emission 528 nm) every 10 min for 4 h; report fluorescence (AFU) normalised to OD600.
steps.source_quote: OD600 and sfGFP fluorescence (excitation 485 nm, emission 528 nm) were measured every 10 minutes for 4 hours, and fluorescence (AFU) normalised to OD600 was reported.

assumptions: Layout: transform_plate, agar spots, overnight, subculture and reader plates all use A1:H9 with the same mapping: columns 1-8 = pEX05 (sfGFP), column 9 = pEX01 positive control; 8 rows = 8 replicates per column (assumed). Columns 1-4 undiluted spots sampled by single pierce (high density); columns 5-8 5-fold diluted spots sampled by spiral (low density). Column 9 receives no L-arabinose (negative control).

Transformation volumes: LV configuration (10 µL cells, 1 µL DNA at 1.5e-4 pmol, 50 µL SOC) taken from the Fig. 4 legend; the paper does not state Fig. 5 used exactly these. Heat shock 4 °C 30 min, 42 °C 30 s, SOC recovery 37 °C 1 h are the defaults from s2.2.
Competent cells prepared by Hanahan method per s4.2; any wash assumed to use ice-cold 0.1 M CaCl2; commercial Thermo BL21(DE3) is an alternative. Competent-cell tube volume of 800 µL is assumed.

Antibiotic: pJKR-H-araC (pEX05) is ampicillin resistant (pUC backbone, Addgene 62563); carbenicillin 100 µg/mL used in LB agar and liquid LB (s4.1). pEX01 antibiotic is in an image-only table, assumed also carbenicillin-resistant.

The agar OmniTray is a solid plate, not a liquid container; it is modelled as a plate_96 (8x12 spot grid) with agar spots at A1:H12 positions. Agar volume (about 30-35 mL), carbenicillin in agar, and spot height offset (1-2 mm above agar) are assumed. Agar density 0.911 g/cm3 for rectangular plates (s2.3).
Spot diluent for 5-fold dilution assumed to be LB (not stated); pEX01 control in column 9 spotted undiluted and sampled by single pierce (assumed).
Agar plate incubation after spotting (about 16 h at 37 °C) is assumed; paper does not state it.

Spiral and pierce geometry (radius 1-2 mm, 2-3 rotations, 8-16 points, depth, speed), fresh tip per spot, and mixing the sampling tip in 500 µL LB-carbenicillin (200 µL mix volume, 10 cycles) are assumed.
Overnight culture: 500 µL LB-carbenicillin per deep well, gas-permeable seal, 16-18 h at 37 °C, about 250 rpm; all assumed (paper says only 'overnight culturing').

OD600 of overnight cultures: 1:10 dilution in LB (20 µL + 180 µL) in a clear 96-well plate with LB blanks in column 10; dilution correction applied (assumed; Protocol 7 details are in the supplement).

Subculture: 10 µL overnight into 490 µL LB-carbenicillin (1:50) in deep well plate, grown at 37 °C with shaking until OD600 about 0.2 (about 2-3 h, assumed); s4.5 uses back-dilution to OD600 0.1 for the related experiment.

Induction: 100 mM sterile L-arabinose stock assumed; 6.7 µL per 500 µL gives about 1.33 mM final (s4.4). Induction is done in the subculture plate before transferring 150 µL to the reader plate (assumed ordering).
Plate-reader setup (150 µL per well, black clear-bottom plate, Varioskan LUX, 37 °C, 960 rpm, 485/528 nm, every 10 min for 4 h) from s4.4.
Details of Protocols 2-4 are in Supplementary File 1, not available; values taken from the recovered gap assessment (Addgene 62563 page and paper-internal values) and standard lab practice.
